recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future changes to the composition or expansion of DocumentReference format codes should be handled in THO/IHE/UTG unless a later FHIR-core issue explicitly changes the resource binding.
issue_request: FHIR-13950 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 DocumentReference request to create CodeSystem-backed management for formatCode values and update the existing ValueSet so IHE and HL7-owned codes were not carried as one undifferentiated local list.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by svn revision 13175, preserved as git commit f86337b9ba9648f17f0ea826df8ec607466b9c2d, labeled GF#13950 and GF#14003. That commit replaced the long local source/documentreference/valueset-formatcodes.xml concept list with an external IHE include and corrected the IHE ValueSet OID.
additional_context: Later formatCode work moved the mixed vocabulary management out of FHIR core. FHIR-14104 and the linked terminology discussion established HL7-managed document format codes, while commit 6f1b3314e9956e3c1eb469c13860238345e02d20 removed the old core-local formatcodes ValueSet and changed DocumentReference.content.profile.value[x] to bind to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-HL7FormatCodes. Current THO content composes active IHE format codes with the HL7 Document Format Codes CodeSystem. FHIR-17298 shows that remaining formatCode expansion issues are now being routed to THO/UTG rather than to a restored core-local ValueSet.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active core build includes DocumentReference, and its formatCode successor binding points to THO. Recreating the removed core-local ValueSet or adding a duplicate core CodeSystem would conflict with the later THO/IHE handoff.
